title: Upgrades
help: Upgrade one component of any cluster: a dry run first, then one node at a time, with the old version kept for a rollback.
order_replicas_first: Standbys first, then the primary (after a switchover)
sshHelp: The cluster's stored SSH secret is used, or give a login here (used for this run only, never saved).
busy: A run is in progress on this cluster.
stopRule: It stops at the first node that fails; the next nodes are not touched.
keptIn: The old packages, configs and a manifest are kept on each node in /var/lib/pg_mantra/upgrade/<run>/.
nothingToDo: Everything is at the newest allowed version: nothing to upgrade.
allowUnsaved: Upgrade even if the old package cannot be kept
noLog: Waiting for the first lines of the log…
start: No run yet. Choose a cluster and a component, then start a dry run.
confirmRun: {{comp}} will be upgraded on {{n}} node(s), one at a time, as listed in the plan. Each is restarted once.
confirmRollback: The saved versions of {{comp}} will be put back, one node at a time, and restarted.
s_pause: pause Patroni (no failover during the restart)
s_switchover: switchover: the primary role moves to {{to}}
s_switchoverBack: switchover away from the primary first
s_wait: wait until healthy (stops here if not)
noDiscoveries: Run Discover (with SSH) and save the result first.
repoHelp: Your private repository: added on the nodes for each step, removed after. Empty = the repositories the nodes already have.
repoOnly: Take the packages only from this repository
sshHelpDiscovered: Used for this run only, never saved.
fixFirst: Some nodes could not be checked (see the details). Fix that and run the dry run again.

pb.help: Your own playbooks, by name. Run them on any machines: give the IP addresses and the login. Dry run first, then run, with a rollback.
pb.start: Add a playbook to start: the playbook, its rollback playbook (optional) and the inputs it needs.
pb.deleteText: The playbook and its run history are deleted. Nothing changes on the machines.
pb.sshInventory: Logins in your inventory are used, or give one here (this run only, never saved).
pb.busy: A run of this playbook is in progress.
pb.checkNote: Dry run = ansible-playbook --check --diff: nothing was changed. Tasks that cannot run in check mode (command, shell) are skipped unless they set check_mode: false.
pb.planFailed: The dry run failed. Check the log: some tasks may not support check mode.
pb.noRollback: This playbook has no rollback playbook.
pb.confirmRun: Run {{name}} on {{where}}, with the same machines and inputs as the dry run.
pb.confirmRollback: Run the rollback playbook of {{name}} on {{where}}.
pb.secretsAgain: Passwords are not saved: the ones in the form are sent again.
pb.name: Name
pb.archiveHelp: Roles, templates, files, group_vars, collections... The playbooks can be in it too.
pb.pathHelp: Path inside the archive or repository
pb.gets: Your playbooks also get: the inputs below, pgm.action (plan / run / rollback), pgm.run_id (the run a rollback undoes: use it to keep and find backups) and ansible_check_mode.
pb.inputsHelp: What pg_MANTRA asks before each run. Each one becomes an Ansible variable.
pb.groupsHelp: Groups your playbook uses (hosts:). With a cluster they are filled with the machines where the component runs; with IP addresses every group gets all of them.
pb.requirementsHelp: Collections / roles installed before each run (needs internet or your Galaxy mirror). ansible.posix, community.general and community.postgresql are already there.
pb.title: Ansible Playbooks
pb.ipsHelp: The playbook runs on all of them.
pb.ipsGroups: They are put in the playbook's groups: {{list}}.
pb.runFailed: The run failed. Roll back now, or fix the cause and try again.
pb.runFailedNoRb: The run failed. This playbook has no rollback playbook: fix the cause and try again.
pb.runDone: The playbook finished on every machine.
pb.gitTokenHelp: Used for this pull only, never saved.
pb.gitHelp: The repository is pulled when you save. Give the playbook paths inside it (e.g. upgrade/site.yml). Use Pull Latest to update it later.
pb.pullText: Download {{repo}} @ {{ref}} again. The next runs use the new files.
pb.addAs_textHelp: A single playbook, typed or pasted
pb.addAs_githubHelp: Pull a repository, branch or tag

noTargets: No cluster yet: create one, or run Discover and save the result.
planFailedFix: The dry run failed. See the log, fix the cause (login, repository, version) and try again.
runFailed: The upgrade failed. Roll back now to put the old version back, or fix the cause and try again.
runDone: The upgrade finished on every node.
rollbackFailed: The rollback failed. See the log, then try the rollback again.
rollbackDone: The rollback finished: the old version is back.
